$comment: Pins the canonical Protection Catalog served by atlasent-api and projected by this SDK. Bumping this pin requires vendoring the exact catalog and schema, re-running JSON Schema validation, and reviewing all type/Zod changes. The catalog is read-only discovery metadata and does not grant authority or activate future capabilities.
deviation_from_canonical_commit: 2026-08-30 confidentiality redaction, two rounds, this repo is public: (1) the pinned commit's catalog.json embedded two customer-identifying doc filenames (see the private atlasent repo's own incident record for the originals, deliberately not repeated here) in commercial offer_ref / source_manifest path strings — redacted to generic filenames (PRODUCTION_CHANGE_AUTHORITY.md, GOOGLE_WORKSPACE_ACCESS_AUTHORIZATION.md, matching the existing generic action_pack slugs). (2) generation_provenance.source_manifest listed 77 internal atlasent-repo file paths (including internal-only strategy/roadmap doc names) as build provenance, and every binding_profile.proof.readiness_gates.*.notes carried candid internal commentary on exactly which security controls are unproven — both are now stripped from the public mirror: source_manifest was reduced to a single honest entry (the generator script's own real path+hash, still schema-valid at minItems:1) instead of inventing fake data, and every notes field was replaced with a fixed redaction string. No functional behavior changed — SDK code only reads readiness_gates.*.status, never .notes, and source_manifest is validated only as a non-empty array (never a specific length) outside this repo's own test. Neither redaction bumps canonical_commit; catalog_sha256 above reflects the twice-redacted file, not the byte-identical canonical mirror at canonical_commit. CORRECTION 2026-08-30 (later same day): the atlasent-side rename this deviation note originally hoped would let this field 'eventually go away via a normal re-vendor' will NOT do that. atlasent's own append-only version_history guard requires any file ever cited by history to keep existing at its original path forever, so its generated catalog's per-pack version_history permanently retains the original customer filenames in early entries (and now, in the change_summary prose explaining the 2026-08-30 rename) — confirmed directly against atlasent commit df10e275e2754f9377e7675d11bb64a35a178fbd. A future bump to that commit or later must NOT be a plain byte-copy: it needs a THIRD redaction pass, but a surgical one, not the source_manifest treatment repeated — do NOT collapse every pack's version_history to one synthetic entry, since typescript/src/protectionCatalog.ts exposes this history as real catalog data and doing so would destroy legitimate lifecycle records for the seven other packs (and the non-identifying entries of these two packs), none of which have any customer-naming problem. Instead: redact only the specific source_refs and change_summary values, in only the specific version_history entries of production-change-authority and google-workspace-access-authorization, that actually name a customer — leaving every other entry, and every other pack's full history, untouched. This is in addition to re-applying rounds (1) and (2) above. Separately, and independent of confidentiality: atlasent's main has also diverged substantially from this pin (9 action_packs there vs. 2 here, plus a changed protection-catalog schema hash) — bumping to it is a deliberate product-disclosure decision about which of those 7 new packs to publish, not a mechanical sync, and needs its own review whenever it happens. This deviation field is a standing, permanent fixture of this vendor copy, not a temporary patch awaiting an upstream fix.
